reviewed_behavior: On POSIX, an existing destination supplies its original UID/GID/mode. An absent destination in an existing paper directory inherits that directory UID/GID with0600.
Prepare and verify metadata only on the new temporary descriptor before JSON encoding and replacement; refuse uncertainty with original cleanup and original destination retained.
Never chmod/chown the existing destination, widen private0600 to bypass access, change the service user or modify account bytes through this preventer.
